# Caption Lite

> Browser-first creator video captioning, audio clean-up, reference style matching, and watermark-free WebM/SRT export studio with Deepgram Nova-2, Inception Mercury 3, and Firebase Cloud Sync.

Caption Lite lets Reels, Shorts, and TikTok creators add animated word-by-word captions, trim vertical (9:16), square (1:1), or landscape (16:9) clips, clean room noise with Web Audio API processing, match colors locally from any reference video, and export without watermarks.

## Core Capabilities

- **Video Stage & Local Trim**: Drag-and-drop MP4/WebM/MOV or `.srt` files onto the studio stage, center-crop to 9:16 / 1:1 / 16:9 without stretching, adjust trim start/end sliders, and loop clip playback.
- **Word-by-Word Caption Styles**: Seven animated styles (`Classic`, `Highlight`, `Pop`, `Colour Cycle`, `Karaoke`, `Bounce`, `Neon`) with customizable placement (`Bottom`, `Lower third`, `Centre`), accent color, and font size (`14px`–`38px`).
- **Deepgram Nova-2 Auto-Captions (`/api/transcribe`)**: Server-proxied transcription returning word-level timestamps. Clips over 24 MB are automatically decoded in the browser and re-encoded to a compact 16 kHz mono WAV before upload.
- **Inception Mercury 3 AI Refinement (`/api/captions/refine`)**: Sends caption text strings only (never raw video or audio) to fix punctuation/misheard words, restyle lines short and punchy, or translate into 7 languages.
- **On-Device Web Audio Clean-Up & Reference Matching**: 90 Hz high-pass filter, RMS noise gate, dynamics compressor, and offscreen canvas color/placement sampling run 100% client-side.
- **Persistence & Sync**: Auto-saves studio drafts locally with Undo/Redo (`Ctrl/Cmd+Z`), and syncs timelines and custom style presets across devices via Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore.

## Vercel Backend Environment Variables

Server-side secrets configured in Vercel Project Settings -> Environment Variables (never exposed to browser bundles):

- `DEEPGRAM_API_KEY`: Powers `/api/transcribe` (Deepgram Nova-2 audio transcription).
- `INCEPTION_API_KEY`: Powers `/api/captions/refine` (Inception Mercury 3 text clean-up & translation).
- `APP_URL`: Canonical deployment URL used for self-referential metadata and callbacks.

## Key Routes

- `/` (`#studio`): Main video stage, caption timeline editor, style designer, reference matcher, Mercury 3 AI panel, and WebM/SRT exporter.
- `/#projects`: Cloud Firestore saved projects and custom style presets dashboard (Google Sign-In).
- `/#deploy`: Live Vercel server capability check and Firebase Auth allowlist guide.
- `/#guide`: Step-by-step workflow, technical architecture limits, and creator FAQ.
